Because the relic burn is recorded at the nebula settlement, the signal audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 53% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 289 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
